cards.title: Tags that say what they are
cards.body: `<header>`, `<main>` and `<footer>` look like plain boxes, but they tell browsers and screen readers which part of the page is which.
cards.code:
My blog

Today I learned HTML.

Made by me

hi.title: Tags jo batate hain woh kya hain
hi.body: `<header>`, `<main>` aur `<footer>` saade boxes jaise dikhte hain, par browsers aur screen readers ko batate hain ki page ka kaunsa hissa kya hai.

cards.title: Tags inside tags
cards.body: Tags can hold other tags. Indent the inner ones so you can see the structure at a glance.

hi.title: Tags ke andar tags
hi.body: Tags doosre tags rakh sakte hain. Andar wale tags ko indent karo taaki structure ek nazar mein dikh jaaye.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: One part of this page is closed with the wrong tag. Which line?

bug.fix: Line 2 opens `<main>` but closes `</header>`. Close what you open: `</main>`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Is page ka ek hissa galat tag se band kiya gaya hai. Kaunsi line?
hi.fix: Line 2 `<main>` kholti hai par `</header>` se band karti hai. Jo kholo wahi band karo: `</main>`.

check.question: Which tag holds the page's main content?
check.explanation: `<main>` is the main content. The header comes before it and the footer after it.

hi.question: Kaunsa tag page ka main content rakhta hai?
hi.explanation: `<main>` main content hai. Header usse pehle aata hai aur footer uske baad.

exercise.prompt: Give your page a `<header>` with an `<h1>` inside, a `<main>` with a paragraph inside, and a `<footer>`.
exercise.promptHi: Apne page ko ek `<header>` do jiske andar ek `<h1>` ho, ek `<main>` jiske andar ek paragraph ho, aur ek `<footer>`.
exercise.starterCode: <!-- header (with an h1), main (with a p), footer -->
